cohort: 112 women with a previous cesarean section and 418 women with a previous vaginal delivery who became pregnant after IVF or ICSI
finding: In subfertile women trying to conceive again through IVF or ICSI, a history of Cesarean section was associated with a reduced live birth rate per embryo transfer compared to women with a history of one previous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was associated with a reduced live birth rate per embryo transfer compared to a history of vaginal delivery.
